about: CareCard — what care to get, who to contact and how quickly. Three levels, told apart by the words in the heading (hidden, but read first: "Urgent advice: Call 111 if:"), by the mark and by the edge,

urgency.about: How quickly to get care: non-urgent (a GP, a pharmacy), urgent (111), emergency (999, A&E).

title.about: One call to action: "Speak to a GP if:", "Call 111 if:", "Call 999 or go to A&E now if:".

label.about: The urgency, said before the title as part of the heading. Defaults to the urgency's words.

children.about: A bulleted list of when, even for one item; then a line, if needed.

action.about: Emergency only: the one link it may carry ("Find your nearest A&E").
